- 95th percentile burst days: up to ~22M tokens/day when clinical loads spike (regional batch jobs).

Executive summary
- Baseline assumptions: 300M tokens / month sustained; 95th spikes modeled to 660M tokens in burst month. Model family used for estimate: Redwood-rl-med (production-quality mix).
- Proposed committed bands (monthly):
  * Band A — 250M tokens: $2,750 per 1M tokens (list) -> committed price $1,950 per 1M tokens (25% commit discount)
  * Band B — 500M tokens: $2,250 per 1M tokens (list) -> committed price $1,575 per 1M tokens (30% commit discount)
  * Band C — 1B tokens: $1,900 per 1M tokens (list) -> committed price $1,330 per 1M tokens (30%–35% commit tiering)
- SLA uplift (99.9% low-latency tier): +18% on committed per-1M price for nodes pinned to low-latency pool.
- Example monthly invoice scenarios (see attached PDF page 2 for tables):
  * If Meditect commits to Band B (500M) and runs 300M actual: monthly invoice = approx $472.5K (committed price applied to committed band + overage policy detailed).
  * If Meditect takes Band C (1B) and hits 300M actual: invoice = approx $399K with headroom for bursts.

Attachments (for your review)
- 20261104-Meditect-estimate-v1.pdf (invoice-style estimate with tables)
- meditect_burn_profile.xlsx (detailed token burn, hourly distribution)
- redwood-pricing-calculator.csv (calculator used for per-1M math)

Next steps
1) Please review the PDF and confirm which committed band you want us to convert into a draft SOW.
2) If procurement prefers a PO route, we can produce a billing-ready quote and SOW within 48 hours after band selection.
3) If you need a lower target $/1M we can explore a 12–18 month committed program for deeper discounts — I included that delta in the workbook.
